name: post.publish_job
description: Sends one account's job of a post: the text that account gets, the media and the format. An effect: it sends only what a person approved, and the scheduler calls it at the job's time. A job that no longer waits (cancelled, sent, moved off) sends nothing.
payload: select jsonb_build_object('job', j.id, 'channel', j.channel, 'format', p.format, 'text', brandbase.text_for(p.caption, p.hook, p.draft, j.channel), 'media', p.media) as result from brandbase.post_jobs j join brandbase.posts p on p.id = j.post_id where j.id = :job and j.brand_id = :brand and j.status = 'scheduled'
sql: update brandbase.post_jobs j set status = 'live', external_id = :outcome::jsonb ->> 'externalId', error = null, attempts = j.attempts + 1, updated_at = now() where j.id = :job and j.brand_id = :brand and j.status = 'scheduled' returning j.id, j.status, j.external_id as "externalId"
